thread:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty triggered: GPU_OOM_SURGE in region west2a for service inference-svc. Pager:PD-91234 link: https://pd.example/PD-91234
PagerDuty: Auto-page delivered to Ana (oncall) -> escalation policy: gpu-oncall
Ana: ack'd. pulling up nvml and pod logs now.
Mike: seeing steady nvml allocation failures on node gpu-node-12, dmesg shows repeated SIGBUS from cuda.
Ana: noted. impact? any 5xx spikes?
Jordan: Grafana: tail latency OK for most customers but 502s for low-priority pool jumped to 0.9% starting 03:10 UTC.
Ana: ok that's customer visible for a subset. CS: notify selected accounts, add to incident notes.
Mike: running quick check -> ssh gpu-node-12; nvml top shows 96% mem usage, kvcache evicting. suspect fragmentation + prefetch storm.
Ana: let's degrade noncritical batchers and drop prefetch on low-priority pools. Mike, can you apply temporary throttle?
Mike: applying change: updating config map batcher.max_batch_tokens from 8000 -> 4000 for pool low-priority. command: kubectl -n inference patch configmap batcher-cfg -p '{"data":{"max_batch_tokens":"4000"}}'
Jordan: starting node evacuation for gpu-node-12: kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m ; cordon done. moving pods off.
Ana: good. IncidentBot: created runbook entry /runbooks/gpu-oom-surge with steps performed.
Mike: after throttle + drain, nvml alloc fails decreased and kernel SIGBUS frequency dropped. memory headroom rising from 4% -> 18% in 4m.
CS-Bot: Notified affected trial customers: ticket #CS-7781 created, message template used.
Ana: removing low-priority prefetch entirely for now: patch applied. monitoring for regression.
Jordan: handing off to day shift (Jordan -> Mike) at 04:00 UTC with notes: node gpu-node-12 evacuated, batcher throttled, prefetch disabled; followup: repro on staging with synthetic prefetch load.
Ana: marking incident as acknowledged and under mitigation. leaving channel for postmortem.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty escalation suppressed (duplicate alerts filtered) :bell_with_slash:
Mike: logs show one customer job hit hard OOM earlier; adding per-job qcap to limit allocs.
Ana: Customer impact summary: ~0.9% 502s on low-priority routes for ~12 minutes, no premium customers affected, degradation mitigated within 8 minutes of mitigation start.
Jordan: plan: schedule deeper investigation into kvcache fragmentation and prefetch backpressure tomorrow; potential kernel driver update on suspect nodes.
Ana: will create postmortem stub and assign action items. Thanks everyone.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-91234 resolved by Ana at 04:10 UTC.
Ana: resolved in PD, keeping notes for follow-up. :thumbsup:
